retrieval_policy.rule: The adapter implements only the exact revisions and native field names locked here. A newer Datatracker revision requires a new profile, vectors, and source lock.

locked_requirements: Validate the WIT before the HTTP message signature.
Cover @method and @request-target.
Cover Content-Type, Content-Digest, Authorization, Txn-Token, and Workload-Identity-Token when present.
Require created, expires, nonce, tag, and the request-only wimse-aud signature parameter.
Reject keyid and alg Signature-Input parameters.
Verify Content-Digest whenever a body exists.
Treat WIT as an explicitly typed signed JWT.
Require an asymmetric algorithm and reject none.
Validate the workload subject as a workload identifier scoped to its URI-authority trust domain.
Bind each accepted trust domain to authorized issuers and cryptographic trust anchors out of band.
Require cnf.jwk and proof of possession of the corresponding private key.
Verify the WPT with the WIT confirmation key and require matching EdDSA algorithm pins.
Require the wpt+jwt type, audience, short expiry, unique jti, and wth.
When a Txn-Token is present, require tth over the exact ASCII token value.
When an OAuth access token is present, require ath over the exact bearer token value.
Treat WPT as proof of workload-key possession, not human authorization.
Verify a compact signed JWT with typ txntoken+jwt.
Require iat, aud trust domain, exp, txn, sub, scope, and req_wl.
Treat tctx as immutable transaction context selected by the transaction-token service.
Validate the JWS signature, audience, and expiration before relying on token context.
Use aud plus txn as the stable native replay identity for this AEB profile.
Select issuer keys and algorithms from a pinned trust registry rather than the token header.
Enforce iat and exp bounds, TXN audience, sender constraint, and intent binding.
Recompute spt_intent_digest as base64url SHA-256 over the specified domain separator and JCS intent.
Do not treat human_anchor as proof of human identity or an AEB human-authorization role.

source_gap.details: Revision -03 describes a full-chain parent-byte commitment and a transaction-context hash but does not assign exact interoperable claim names or encodings to them.
source_gap.adapter_effect: The optional SPT TXN is verified only as a pinned signed leaf intent-binding adjunct. It cannot independently satisfy an SPT authorization, human-authorization, or full delegation-chain role.

profile_decisions.wire_format: No new wire format is defined. The AEB artifact is an invocation envelope containing exact native compact values and observed HTTP request fields.
profile_decisions.wimse_audience: The native revision-03 field is wimse-aud inside Signature-Input and therefore inside @signature-params. No Wimse-Audience HTTP header is introduced.
profile_decisions.time_profile: The constructor additionally requires iat, nbf, exp, bounded clock skew, and per-artifact maximum ages for every accepted compact JWT.
profile_decisions.algorithm_profile: This experimental version accepts only EdDSA with canonical Ed25519 SPKI keys pinned at construction.
profile_decisions.role_profile: The adapter emits delegated-workload with subject kind workload. WIT/WPT possession, OAuth context, SPT context, and human_anchor can never become human authorization.
profile_decisions.action_profile: CAID material contains only the signed HTTP action, immutable OAuth transaction context, and optional SPT intent. Issuer, identity, audience, and replay identifiers remain verified evidence metadata rather than material-action content.
profile_decisions.missing_action: A missing or ambiguously shaped expected action is INDETERMINATE and produces no CAID.
